edits.new: The plant grows leafier and fills out to its full size, usually about two feet tall, building up before it flowers. Beans make much of their own food (nitrogen) at this stage. You want healthy green growth, not huge dark leafy plants, which often mean too much fertilizer and fewer beans later.

edits.new: Steady leafy growth as the bush fills out to its full height of about two feet and builds the canopy that will support flowering. The plant is fixing much of its own nitrogen now through root nodules, so vigorous but not lush, overfed growth is the goal. Overly dark, leafy plants with little branching signal excess nitrogen and forecast a poor pod set.
